confirm.title: C6 Zigbee Stick found
confirm.description:
An ESP32-C6 Zigbee coordinator is connected.

Port: `{device}`
Firmware: {firmware}

Submit to install and start Zigbee2MQTT for it (and the Mosquitto broker, if Home Assistant has no MQTT broker yet). This takes a minute or two.

progress.setup_z2m: Installing and starting Zigbee2MQTT. This can take a few minutes.

abort.already_configured: This stick is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No ESP32-C6 is connected over USB.
abort.not_zboss: The ESP32-C6 does not answer as a Zigbee coordinator. Flash the coordinator firmware first: https://f1devbin.github.io/c6-zigbee-stick/
abort.port_busy: The port is in use by another program.
abort.z2m_other_adapter: Zigbee2MQTT already works with another adapter, so it was left as it is.
abort.z2m_setup_failed: Zigbee2MQTT could not be set up: {error}
